/* v0.4 homepage polish */
body{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}

:root{--bg:#f6f5f1;--paper:#fffdf9;--ink:#151515;--muted:#746f67;--line:#e5e0d8;--soft:#f8f6f1;--soft2:#efebe4;--radius:24px}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Songti SC","STSong","SimSun","Noto Serif CJK SC",serif;line-height:1.72}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}img{display:block;max-width:100%}
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(246,245,241,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.topbar-inner{max-width:1220px;margin:auto;padding:14px 26px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.brand{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}.nav{display:flex;gap:28px}.nav a{font-size:15px;font-weight:700}
main{max-width:1220px;margin:auto;padding:0 26px 80px}.hero{padding:84px 0 40px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.hero h1{margin:0;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-size:clamp(66px,9vw,104px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.06em}.hero-lead{margin-top:18px;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;max-width:900px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:22px;margin-top:30px}.card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:27px}.card-title{margin:0 0 17px;font-size:23px;font-weight:800}.sop-chain{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}.sop-step{min-height:88px;padding:15px 14px;border:1px solid #e8e3db;border-radius:15px;background:var(--soft)}.sop-step .idx{display:block;margin-bottom:9px;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#8b847b}.sop-step strong{font-size:16px}
.formula-kicker{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b847b}.formula{margin-top:13px;padding:15px 17px;border:1px solid #ebe6de;border-radius:15px;background:var(--soft);font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;font-size:23px;line-height:1.25}.note{margin-top:15px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:15px;background:#f3efe7;border:1px solid #e5ded3;color:#5a534a;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}
.section{padding-top:76px}.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;margin-bottom:22px}.section-head h2{margin:0;font-size:48px;line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.035em;font-weight:800}.section-head p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;max-width:540px}.quick-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.quick{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:19px;padding:21px}.quick .n{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#8b847b}.quick h3{margin:9px 0 8px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.3}.quick p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:#5e5952;line-height:1.8}
.exam{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;margin:26px 0;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.02)}.exam-head{padding:22px 26px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}.exam-title h3{margin:0;font-size:25px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.025em}.tagrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:9px}.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#f7f4ee;border:1px solid #e7e1d8;color:#6d665e;font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:600}.score{flex:0 0 auto;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #d3cdc4;background:#fbfaf7;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.exam-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.06fr) minmax(0,.94fr)}.original{padding:20px;background:#f0eee9;border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:390px}.original img{width:100%;max-height:500px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.05);background:white}.solution{padding:26px 28px}.label{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b847b;margin-bottom:9px}.solution h4{margin:0 0 11px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.45}.solution p{margin:0 0 13px;font-size:16px;color:#35312d;line-height:1.82}.sop{margin:15px 0;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid #e7e1d9;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.75}.warn{margin-top:15px;padding:14px 15px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e3ce73;background:#fcf7da;color:#4b4435;font-size:15px;line-height:1.72}details{margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;list-style:none}summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}details .inner{padding-top:10px}details .inner p{margin:0;font-size:16px}
.checklist{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:8px}.check{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:16px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:16px;font-weight:700}.check-no{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8a837b}.check-text{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.box{width:16px;height:16px;border:1.5px solid #a79f94;border-radius:4px;flex:0 0 auto}.footer{margin-top:76px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:#81796f;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:980px){.grid,.exam-body,.quick-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.original{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:0}.section-head{display:block}.section-head p{margin-top:9px}}
@media(max-width:760px){main{padding:0 18px 58px}.topbar-inner{padding:13px 18px}.nav{gap:16px}.nav a{font-size:14px}.hero{padding-top:68px}.hero-lead{font-size:18px}.section-head h2{font-size:40px}.sop-chain{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.exam-head{padding:20px}.solution{padding:22px 20px}}

/* unified site navigation */
.brand a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.chapter-link{font-family:"Songti SC","STSong","SimSun",serif;font-weight:700}
.knowledge-list{display:grid;gap:12px}.knowledge-item{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:0 20px}.knowledge-item summary{padding:18px 0;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.knowledge-item summary::after{content:"＋";font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;color:#8b847b;font-weight:500}.knowledge-item[open] summary::after{content:"－"}.knowledge-body{padding:0 0 18px;color:#4f4a44;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9}.knowledge-body p{margin:0 0 10px}.knowledge-body p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.knowledge-formula{font-family:"Times New Roman",serif;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid #e8e3db;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;margin:10px 0;color:#222}

/* v0.4 polish */
html{scroll-padding-top:72px}
body{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
.topbar{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(34,30,24,.015)}
.topbar-inner{min-height:56px}
.nav{overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;white-space:nowrap}.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav a{position:relative;opacity:.72;transition:opacity .18s ease}.nav a:hover,.nav a.is-active{opacity:1}
.nav a[href^="#"]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:-7px;height:1.5px;background:var(--ink);transition:right .18s ease}
.nav a[href^="#"].is-active::after{right:0}
.hero{padding-top:88px;padding-bottom:46px}
.hero-lead{line-height:1.62;letter-spacing:.005em}
.section{padding-top:82px}
.section-head{margin-bottom:24px}
.section-head h2{font-family:"Songti SC","STSong","SimSun","Noto Serif CJK SC",serif;letter-spacing:-.045em}
.section-head p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;color:#837c73}
.card,.quick,.exam,.presence{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(37,31,25,.018)}
.card,.quick{transition:border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.quick:hover{border-color:#d8d1c7;transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(40,34,27,.035)}
.sop-step{transition:border-color .18s ease,background .18s ease}.sop-step:hover{border-color:#d8d1c7;background:#fbf9f5}
.formula{letter-spacing:.006em}
/* knowledge accordions: override generic details rules */
.knowledge-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
details.knowledge-item{margin:0;padding:0 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;background:var(--paper);transition:border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}
details.knowledge-item:hover{border-color:#d8d1c7}
details.knowledge-item[open]{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(40,34,27,.03)}
.knowledge-item summary{padding:18px 0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.005em;border:0}
.knowledge-item summary::after{font-size:17px;margin-left:18px}
.knowledge-body{padding:0 0 19px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.92;max-width:900px}
.knowledge-formula{font-size:17px;line-height:1.55}
/* exam cards */
.exam{border-radius:24px;margin:24px 0 30px}
.exam-head{padding:21px 25px 19px}
.exam-title h3{font-family:"Songti SC","STSong","SimSun","Noto Serif CJK SC",serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.tag{background:#faf8f3;color:#716960;border-color:#e6e0d7;padding:4px 9px}
.score{background:transparent}
.original{background:#f2f0eb;padding:18px}
.original img{cursor:zoom-in;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.original img:hover{transform:scale(1.006);box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.07)}
.solution{padding:27px 29px}
.solution h4{font-size:19px}
.sop{background:#f8f6f1;border-color:#e5dfd6}
.warn{background:#faf4d7}
/* real interactive checklist */
.check{padding:15px 2px;font-size:15.5px}
.check-text{cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.check-box{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:16px;height:16px;border:1.5px solid #a79f94;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;display:inline-grid;place-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;cursor:pointer;transition:.16s ease}
.check-box::after{content:"";width:8px;height:4px;border-left:1.8px solid #fff;border-bottom:1.8px solid #fff;transform:rotate(-45deg) scale(0);transition:transform .12s ease;margin-top:-2px}
.check-box:checked{background:#26231f;border-color:#26231f}.check-box:checked::after{transform:rotate(-45deg) scale(1)}
.check:has(.check-box:checked) .check-text>span{color:#8b847b;text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-decoration-color:#bcb4aa}
/* chapter pager */
.chapter-pager{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:64px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.chapter-pager a{min-height:92px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;transition:.18s ease}
.chapter-pager a:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:#d5cec4;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(40,34,27,.035)}
.chapter-pager .dir{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b847b;margin-bottom:5px}
.chapter-pager .name{font-size:17px;font-weight:800}.chapter-pager .next{text-align:right;align-items:flex-end}
/* lightbox */
.image-lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(17,15,12,.88);z-index:100;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:28px;cursor:zoom-out}
.image-lightbox.open{display:flex}.image-lightbox img{max-width:min(96vw,1500px);max-height:94vh;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;background:white;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .topbar-inner{gap:12px}.brand{flex:0 0 auto}.nav{gap:15px;padding-bottom:1px}
  .hero{padding-top:64px}.section{padding-top:64px}.section-head{margin-bottom:18px}
  .exam{border-radius:20px}.exam-title h3{font-size:21px}.score{font-size:11px}
  .chapter-pager{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-top:50px}.chapter-pager .next{text-align:left;align-items:flex-start}
}


/* v0.5 content polish */
section[id]{scroll-margin-top:78px}
.card-title,.quick h3,.solution h4,.knowledge-item summary,.chapter-pager .name{font-family:"Songti SC","STSong","SimSun","Noto Serif CJK SC",serif}
.card-title{letter-spacing:-.02em}
.quick h3{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.quick p,.solution p,.knowledge-body{letter-spacing:.002em}
.formula,.knowledge-formula{font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums}
.formula{font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,23px);overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap}
.formula sub,.formula sup,.knowledge-formula sub,.knowledge-formula sup{font-size:.68em;line-height:0}
.knowledge-body{max-width:920px;color:#49443e}
.knowledge-body b{color:#24211e;font-weight:800}
.knowledge-note{position:relative;margin-top:14px;padding:29px 15px 12px;border-left:0;border:1px solid #e5ded4;border-radius:13px;background:#f6f3ed;color:#5b554e}
.knowledge-note::before{content:"CLOVER NOTE";position:absolute;left:15px;top:8px;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:800;color:#938a7f}
details.knowledge-item[open] summary{color:#171512}
.knowledge-item summary:hover{color:#49423a}
.original img{object-position:top center}
.solution .label{margin-bottom:8px}
.tag{font-family:"Songti SC","STSong","SimSun","Noto Serif CJK SC",serif}
.check{transition:background .15s ease}.check:hover{background:rgba(255,253,249,.42)}
.check-text{width:100%}
@media(max-width:760px){.knowledge-item summary{font-size:16px}.knowledge-body{font-size:14.5px}.formula{white-space:normal}}


/* v0.8 editorial polish */
.knowledge-body .knowledge-lead{font-size:16px;line-height:1.88;color:#292621;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:9px;letter-spacing:.005em}
.knowledge-body p:not(.knowledge-lead){color:#57514a;line-height:1.86}
.knowledge-item{transition:border-color .16s ease,background .16s ease}
.knowledge-item[open]{border-color:#d9d2c7;background:#fffefb}
.knowledge-item summary{letter-spacing:-.01em}
.solution details{margin-top:18px;padding-top:0;border-top:0}
.solution details summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #e6e0d7;border-radius:12px;background:#faf8f3;font-size:14px}
.solution details summary::after{content:"＋";font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;color:#8b847b;font-weight:500}
.solution details[open] summary::after{content:"－"}
.solution details .inner{padding:13px 14px 2px}
.sop{position:relative;padding-top:33px}
.sop::before{content:"SOP";position:absolute;left:16px;top:10px;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#938a7f}
.original img{cursor:zoom-in}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .topbar-inner{align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
  .nav{overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;max-width:68vw;padding:2px 0 4px;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
  .nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .nav a{flex:0 0 auto}
  .knowledge-body .knowledge-lead{font-size:15px}
}


/* V1.0 exam editorial pass */
.exam-flow{margin:13px 0 0}.flow-label{display:block;margin-bottom:5px;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#918a80}.exam-flow p{margin:0;font-size:16px;color:#35312d;line-height:1.82}.sop .flow-label{margin-bottom:6px}.exam-tip{margin-top:15px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:15px;background:#f7f3e9;border:1px solid #e7dfcf;color:#534c43;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}.exam-tip .flow-label{margin-bottom:4px;color:#8a795e}.solution details summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.solution details summary::before{content:"RESULT";font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#958d82}.solution .label{margin-bottom:7px}



/* ===== Single-file application shell ===== */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{min-height:100vh}
.sitebar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(246,245,241,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(15px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sitebar-inner{max-width:1220px;margin:auto;padding:13px 26px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}
.site-brand{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;white-space:nowrap}
.site-brand a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.site-nav{display:flex;gap:25px;align-items:center;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;white-space:nowrap}
.site-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.site-nav a{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;opacity:.72;transition:.15s}.site-nav a:hover,.site-nav a.is-active{opacity:1}
#app{min-height:70vh}
#app>main,.single-main{max-width:1220px;margin:auto;padding:0 26px 80px}
.single-home{max-width:1220px;margin:auto;padding:0 26px 80px}
.single-footer{max-width:1220px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 26px 28px;color:#81796f;font-size:12px}.single-footer-inner{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:20px}
.route-fade{animation:routeFade .18s ease both}@keyframes routeFade{from{opacity:.25;transform:translateY(3px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.chapter-pager a{cursor:pointer}
.image-lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;background:rgba(18,16,14,.82);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:28px;cursor:zoom-out}.image-lightbox.open{display:flex}.image-lightbox img{max-width:min(96vw,1500px);max-height:92vh;object-fit:contain;background:white;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.route-chip{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){.sitebar-inner{padding:12px 18px;display:block}.site-brand{margin-bottom:8px}.site-nav{gap:18px;margin:0 -2px}.site-nav a{font-size:14px}.single-home,.single-main{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}.single-footer{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}}

/* v1.3 content polish */
.quick p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.68;color:#625d56}
.quick h3{margin-bottom:6px}
.exam-flow p{margin-bottom:0}
.exam-tip{line-height:1.68}
.knowledge-body p{max-width:980px}

/* v1.6 exam coverage + score reminders */
.coverage-card{margin:0 0 22px;padding:17px 19px;background:#f8f5ef;border:1px solid #e5ded3;border-radius:16px;color:#5a544c;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}
.coverage-card strong{color:#26221e;font-weight:800}.coverage-card .coverage-kicker{display:block;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b847b;margin-bottom:6px}
.score-tip{margin-top:13px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;background:#f4f1eb;border:1px solid #e5ded4;color:#4f4942;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}
.score-tip .flow-label{margin-right:8px}
@media(max-width:760px){.coverage-card{padding:15px 16px}.score-tip{padding:11px 12px}}


/* v1.7 exam-priority polish */
.priority-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:18px}
.priority-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #ddd6cd;border-radius:999px;background:#fbf9f5;font-size:12px;line-height:1.2;color:#5d574f;font-weight:700}
.priority-pill b{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,sans-serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b847b}
.priority-pill.hot{background:#f4efe6;border-color:#d8cec0;color:#302c27}
.priority-pill.hot b{color:#6e6256}
@media(max-width:760px){.priority-strip{gap:7px;margin-top:15px}.priority-pill{font-size:11.5px;padding:6px 9px}}


/* v2.0 course-focus content refinement */
.mock-exam .exam-body{display:block}
.mock-exam .solution{max-width:980px;padding:25px 28px 27px}
.mock-exam .exam-head{background:#fcfaf6}
.mock-exam .label{color:#776f65}
@media(max-width:760px){.mock-exam .solution{padding:22px 20px}}


/* v2.1 Core Notes / Note Atlas */
.note-atlas{padding-top:72px}.note-atlas .section-head{margin-bottom:14px}
.note-atlas-intro{max-width:780px;margin:0 0 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.85}
.note-atlas-grid{display:grid;gap:18px}
.note-panel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,.88fr) minmax(0,1.12fr);overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px}
.note-panel.no-image{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.note-figure{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:250px;padding:18px;background:#f1eee8;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}
.note-figure img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:410px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 7px 24px rgba(35,30,24,.06)}
.note-copy{padding:27px 29px 28px}.note-kicker{font:800 10px/1.2 Inter,ui-sans-serif,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b847b}
.note-copy h3{margin:9px 0 11px;font-size:25px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.note-copy p{margin:0;color:#5f5952;font-size:15px;line-height:1.9}.note-copy p+p{margin-top:9px}
.note-formulas{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:17px}
.note-formula{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #e3ddd4;border-radius:11px;background:#f8f5ef;font-family:"Times New Roman","STIX Two Text",serif;font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;color:#25211d}
.note-tip{margin-top:17px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:#625b53;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.75}.note-tip b{color:#28231f}
@media(max-width:800px){.note-atlas{padding-top:58px}.note-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr}.note-figure{min-height:0;padding:12px;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.note-copy{padding:21px 20px 23px}.note-copy h3{font-size:22px}.note-formula{font-size:17px}}
</style>
<!-- content-polish: v1.6 -->
</head>
<body>
<header class="sitebar"><div class="sitebar-inner"><div class="site-brand"><a href="#home">Analog Survival Guide</a></div><nav class="site-nav" id="siteNav" aria-label="站内导航"></nav></div></header>
<div id="app"></div>
<footer class="single-footer"><div class="single-footer-inner">Clover 大聪明的模电网站</div></footer>
<div id="globalLightbox" class="image-lightbox" aria-hidden="true"><img alt="原题大图"></div>
<template id="tpl-home"><main class="single-home"><section class="hero"><div class="eyebrow">Clover's Analog Electronics</div><h1>Analog Survival Guide</h1><div class="sub">Clover 大聪明的模电网站</div></section><section class="section"><div class="section-head"><h2>章节</h2></div><div class="grid">
<a class="chapter-card" href="#diode"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">01</span><span>DIODE</span></div><h2>二极管与稳压管</h2><p>PN结、模型、温度、稳压</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#fet"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">02</span><span>FET</span></div><h2>场效应管</h2><p>JFET、MOSFET、Q点、小信号</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#bjt"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">03</span><span>BJT</span></div><h2>双极型晶体管</h2><p>静态、动态、共射/共集/共基</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#frequency"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">04</span><span>FREQ</span></div><h2>频率响应</h2><p>截止频率、通频带、相频</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#diff"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">05</span><span>DIFF</span></div><h2>差动放大</h2><p>差模、共模、恒流源</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#feedback"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">06</span><span>FEEDBACK</span></div><h2>反馈</h2><p>组态、深反馈、阻抗变化</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#opamp"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">07</span><span>OP AMP</span></div><h2>运放与比较器</h2><p>运算、比较器、迟滞</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#power"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">08</span><span>POWER AMP</span></div><h2>功率放大</h2><p>OCL/OTL、效率、管耗</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#oscillator"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">09</span><span>OSC</span></div><h2>正弦波振荡</h2><p>RC、LC、振荡条件</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
<a class="chapter-card" href="#modulation"><div class="code"><span class="chapter-no">10</span><span>MOD</span></div><h2>调制</h2><p>AM、FM、带宽、功率</p><div class="enter">进入章节 →</div></a>
</div></section></main></template>
<template id="tpl-diode"><main class="single-main">
<section class="hero"><h1>DIODE</h1><div class="hero-lead">先判导通 / 截止，再选二极管模型；稳压管先看是否进入反向击穿区，最后再写节点电压与电流</div><div class="priority-strip" aria-label="本章复习优先级"><span class="priority-pill hot"><b>COURSE</b>定义 / 模型 / 参数</span><span class="priority-pill"><b>HIGH</b>状态判断 + 温度</span><span class="priority-pill"><b>AWARE</b>稳压管反向击穿</span></div></section>
<section class="grid" id="quick">
<div class="card"><h2 class="card-title">通用解题链</h2><div class="sop-chain">
<div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">01</span><strong>认器件类型</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">02</span><strong>判正反偏</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">03</span><strong>判导通 / 截止</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">04</span><strong>选等效模型</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">05</span><strong>写节点电压</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">06</span><strong>求支路电流</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">07</span><strong>检查假设</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">08</span><strong>看温度 / 稳压</strong></div>
</div></div>
<div class="card"><div class="formula-kicker">Core Formula</div><div class="formula">i<sub>D</sub> = I<sub>S</sub>(e<sup>u<sub>D</sub>/U<sub>T</sub></sup> − 1)</div><div class="formula">r<sub>d</sub> ≈ U<sub>T</sub> / I<sub>DQ</sub></div><div class="formula">硅二极管恒压降模型：U<sub>on</sub> ≈ 0.7 V</div><div class="note">复习主线很清楚：半导体基本概念 → PN 结 → 二极管模型 → 基本应用 → 稳压管。做电路题时始终先判器件状态，再选模型；稳压管只有进入反向击穿区后，才真正进入“稳压”状态。</div></div>
</section>
<section class="section"><div class="section-head"><h2>速通</h2></div><div class="quick-grid">
<div class="quick"><div class="n">01 · 半导体</div><h3>N 型五价，P 型三价</h3><p>N 型：五价、电子多；P 型：三价、空穴多。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">02 · PN 结</div><h3>核心就是单向导电</h3><p>正偏易导通，反偏电流很小；应用判断都从单向导电出发。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">03 · 大信号</div><h3>先选模型，再算电路</h3><p>先看题设选模型：理想导通≈短路；硅管恒压降常取 0.7 V。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">04 · 小信号</div><h3>动态电阻和静态电流反着变</h3><p>小信号看 r<sub>d</sub>；I<sub>DQ</sub> 越大，r<sub>d</sub> 越小。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">05 · 温度</div><h3>温度升高，正向特性会移动</h3><p>固定正向电流时：温度升高，正向导通电压减小。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">06 · 稳压管</div><h3>反向击穿不是“坏了”</h3><p>先判是否进入反向击穿区；没进入，就不能直接写 U<sub>Z</sub>。</p></div>
</div></section>

<section class="section note-atlas" id="notes">
<div class="section-head"><h2>核心笔记</h2></div>
<p class="note-atlas-intro">二极管这章先抓状态判断。图里已经有的内容不再重复打字，下面只留做题时会用到的结论。</p>
<div class="note-atlas-grid">

<article class="note-panel">
<div class="note-figure"><img loading="lazy" src="assets/notes/diode-pn.jpg" alt="N型P型半导体与PN结形成的原笔记图"></div>
<div class="note-copy">
<h3>先判断偏置方向，再决定导通还是截止</h3>
<p>先看外加电压让耗尽层变窄还是变宽，再判断载流子运动和器件状态。整流、限幅、稳压题都从这一步开始。</p>
<div class="note-formulas"><div class="note-formula">正偏：耗尽层变窄 → 扩散增强 → 易导通</div><div class="note-formula">反偏：耗尽层变宽 → 扩散受阻 → 电流很小</div></div>
<div class="note-tip"><b>做题时：</b>先判状态，再列式。别反过来。</div>
</div></article>

<article class="note-panel">
<div class="note-figure"><img loading="lazy" src="assets/notes/diode-model.jpg" alt="二极管伏安特性与模型的原笔记图"></div>
<div class="note-copy">
<h3>大信号看工作状态，小信号看工作点附近变化</h3>
<p>直流题先看题目采用理想模型、恒压降模型还是折线模型；交流微小变化再用工作点附近的小信号电阻。</p>
<div class="note-formulas"><div class="note-formula">Si 常用导通压降约 0.7 V　｜　Ge 约 0.3 V</div><div class="note-formula">小信号：r<sub>d</sub> ≈ U<sub>T</sub> / I<sub>DQ</sub></div></div>
<div class="note-tip"><b>注意：</b>题目明确给了模型，就按题设模型算，不要自己换模型。</div>
</div></article>

<article class="note-panel">
<div class="note-figure"><img loading="lazy" src="assets/notes/diode-limiter.jpg" alt="二极管限幅电路与波形判断原笔记图"></div>
<div class="note-copy">
<h3>限幅题：先看二极管两端电位，再分区间画波形</h3>
<p>不需要背每种接法的波形。先假设截止，算两端电位；假设不成立时再切换到导通状态。</p>
<div class="note-formulas"><div class="note-formula">假设状态 → 算两端电位 → 检查自洽 → 必要时重算</div></div>
<div class="note-tip"><b>画波形：</b>输入跨过阈值的位置先在横轴上标出来，再一段一段画。</div>
</div></article>

<article class="note-panel">
<div class="note-figure"><img loading="lazy" src="assets/notes/diode-zener.jpg" alt="稳压管限幅与输出波形原笔记图"></div>
<div class="note-copy">
<h3>稳压管：先假设没稳压，再用结果反证</h3>
<p>稳压管只是多了一个反向稳压状态，本质仍然是状态判断。先按未进入稳压区处理，结果不自洽再切换状态。</p>
<div class="note-formulas"><div class="note-formula">正向导通区　｜　中间截止区　｜　反向稳压区</div><div class="note-formula">保持正向电流不变：温度 ↑ → 正向导通电压 ↓</div></div>
<div class="note-tip"><b>记住：</b>限幅、稳压综合题都适合用“先假设 → 再验证”这套方法。</div>
</div></article>

</div></section>
<section class="section" id="knowledge"><div class="section-head"><h2>知识点详解</h2></div><div class="knowledge-list">
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>01｜半导体与 PN 结</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">先把 N/P 型和 PN 结吃透，这一章后面几乎都只是应用。N 型多数载流子是电子，P 型多数载流子是空穴；PN 结的单向导电性则是整流、限幅和稳压判断的起点。</p><p>选择填空最容易直接考：N 型掺五价元素，P 型掺三价元素。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>02｜二极管工作状态判断</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">遇到二极管电路，不要先算电流，先判断它到底导通还是截止。最稳的流程是：先假设状态 → 用对应模型替换 → 解电路 → 再回头检查假设。</p><p>典型例题反复练的就是“有没有电流、二极管是否导通”，本质上是在训练这套判断顺序。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>03｜大信号模型与小信号模型</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">大信号模型和小信号模型都被单独列进本章总结。大信号分析更偏整流、限幅和导通/截止；小信号分析则是在一个既定直流工作状态附近研究微小变化。</p><p>做题先看题目问的是工作状态，还是某个静态点附近的小交流变化。两套模型不要混用。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>04｜温度特性</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">在保持正向电流不变时，二极管正向导通电压会随温度升高而减小。</p><p>这一条很像选择 / 填空直接考结论，考前记牢即可。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>05｜稳压管：先判断是否进入稳压区</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">稳压管重点看反向击穿特性。跨章节题可以固定用一个很好用的思路：先假设还没有达到稳压条件，按无稳压电流处理；如果算出的结果与假设矛盾，再切换到稳压状态。</p><p>这套判断后面还会出现在差动放大、运放限幅和比较器里，所以第一章学会后要一直保留。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>06｜这一章考试到底抓什么</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">本章最后压成六块就够：半导体基本概念、PN 结单向导电、二极管特性与参数、大/小信号模型、二极管基本应用、稳压管反向击穿。</p><p>“基本应用”里最值得保留的关键词是整流、限幅和稳压：本质都先回到单向导电与器件状态判断。现有四套真题里，本章更常以选择、填空或跨章节小问出现，所以复习目标是判断快、模型稳、结论熟。</p></div></details>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="papers"><div class="section-head"><h2>历年考法</h2><p>这四套卷里，二极管 / 稳压管没有单独占一整道大题，主要以选择填空和综合电路里的基础判断出现，所以重点是“结论必须熟 + 模型不能选错”。</p></div><div class="coverage-card"><span class="coverage-kicker">Exam Coverage</span>四套卷里，这一章主要以选择、填空和跨章节基础判断出现，没有独立大题。<strong>不要因为分值小就跳过：</strong>掺杂、温度、动态电阻、稳压状态都属于很适合直接送分的结论题。</div>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2018–2019 A卷 · 选择填空</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">N / P 型</span><span class="tag">掺杂</span><span class="tag">稳压管</span></div></div><div class="score">基础送分</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2018-2019 二极管考法" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>送分题：掺杂 + 稳压管</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>直接考基础结论：N/P 型掺杂怎么记，稳压管靠什么机理稳压。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>N 型 → 五价；P 型 → 三价；稳压管 → 反向击穿</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>别把 N/P 型掺杂记反，也别把稳压管写成“正向导通稳压”。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>这类题几乎不需要计算：把“掺杂—多数载流子—稳压管状态”按关键词直接对应，别在送分题上犹豫。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>N 型掺入五价元素，P 型掺入三价元素；稳压管利用<strong>反向击穿特性</strong>实现稳压。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2019–2020 B卷 · 第2空</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">本征半导体</span><span class="tag">P 型</span><span class="tag">载流子浓度</span></div></div><div class="score">1 分 · 概念题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2019-2020 半导体载流子" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先分本征，再看多数载流子</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>本征半导体中电子与空穴浓度相等；掺杂后再判断谁是多数载流子。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>本征：n=p → P 型：p>n → N 型：n>p</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>多数载流子不是“唯一载流子”。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先把材料看成本征半导体，再由掺杂判断多数载流子；不要直接从“N/P 型”倒推而漏掉题设过程。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>P 型半导体中<strong>空穴浓度大于电子浓度</strong>；本征半导体中<strong>空穴浓度等于电子浓度</strong>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2020–2021 A卷 · 第1题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">二极管</span><span class="tag">温度</span><span class="tag">正向电流</span></div></div><div class="score">1 分 · 高频概念</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2020-2021 二极管温度题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先看题目固定的是电压还是电流</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>这里固定 U_D。按课程笔记的温度结论，温度升高后同一正向电压下电流增大。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>固定 U_D → 温度升高 → I_D 增大</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>温度题一定先辨清“固定 U_D”还是“固定 I_D”。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>题目固定的是正向电压，所以只判断电流随温度的变化；不要把“固定电流时导通压降变化”混进来。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>温度升高 10 ℃ 且 U<sub>D</sub> 不变时，I<sub>D</sub> <strong>大于 10 mA</strong>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2021–2022 B卷 · 第4题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">小信号</span><span class="tag">动态电阻</span><span class="tag">工作点</span></div></div><div class="score">1 分 · 模型题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2021-2022 二极管动态电阻" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>小信号题先看静态电流</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>直流电源增大后，静态正向电流增大；动态电阻 r_d 随 I_DQ 增大而减小。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>V 增大 → I_DQ 增大 → r_d 减小</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>别把小信号动态电阻和直流等效电阻混在一起。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先写 r<sub>d</sub> 与 I<sub>DQ</sub> 的关系，再判断方向，过程只要两步就够。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>二极管动态电阻 <strong>r<sub>d</sub> 减小</strong>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
</section>
<article class="exam mock-exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2026 模拟测验 · 选择填空第1题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">P 型半导体</span><span class="tag">PN 结反偏</span><span class="tag">稳压管</span><span class="tag">动态电阻</span></div></div><div class="score">4 个结论 · 基础送分</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="solution"><div class="label">2026 MOCK</div><h4>这一组题专门检验第一章的“结论反应速度”</h4><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">得分链</span>P 型：空穴浓度更大 → PN 结反偏增大：耗尽层变宽 → 稳压：利用反向击穿区 → 正向电流增大：r<sub>d</sub> 减小</div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span>温度、电压、电流题一定先看“保持谁不变”；动态电阻和直流等效电阻不要混用。</div></div></div></article>
<section class="section" id="check"><div class="section-head"><h2>考前清单</h2><p>这章不难，但最容易因为概念混淆白丢分。</p></div><div class="checklist">
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">01</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>N 型五价、P 型三价记反了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">02</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>多数 / 少数载流子分清了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">03</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>二极管先判导通 / 截止，再选模型了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">04</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>硅管恒压降模型的 0.7 V 用在该用的地方了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">05</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>小信号 r<sub>d</sub> 与 I<sub>DQ</sub> 的反比关系记住了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">06</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>温度升高时，正向压降 / 正向电流的变化方向分清了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">07</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>稳压管有没有真的进入反向击穿区，检查了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">08</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>限幅 / 钳位题有没有逐段判断二极管状态？</span></div></div>
</div></section>
<nav aria-label="章节切换" class="chapter-pager"><a href="#modulation"><span class="dir">上一章</span><span class="name">← 调制</span></a><a class="next" href="#fet"><span class="dir">下一章</span><span class="name">场效应管 →</span></a></nav>
</main></template>
<template id="tpl-fet"><main class="single-main">
<section class="hero"><h1>FET</h1><div class="hero-lead">认管型、求 Q 点、校验工作区、画小信号模型、算 A<sub>u</sub> / R<sub>i</sub> / R<sub>o</sub></div><div class="priority-strip" aria-label="本章复习优先级"><span class="priority-pill hot"><b>COURSE</b>N 沟道 JFET + 增强型 NMOS</span><span class="priority-pill"><b>HIGH</b>Q 点：解析 / 图解</span><span class="priority-pill"><b>HIGH</b>共源 Aᵤ / Rᵢ / Rₒ</span></div></section>
<section class="grid" id="quick">
<div class="card"><h2 class="card-title">通用解题链</h2><div class="sop-chain">
<div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">01</span><strong>认管型</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">02</span><strong>画直流通路</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">03</span><strong>写器件方程</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">04</span><strong>求 Q 点</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">05</span><strong>校验工作区</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">06</span><strong>画交流等效</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">07</span><strong>小信号模型</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">08</span><strong>A<sub>u</sub> / R<sub>i</sub> / R<sub>o</sub></strong></div>
</div></div>
<div class="card"><div class="formula-kicker">Core Formula</div><div class="formula">U<sub>GS</sub> = U<sub>G</sub> − U<sub>S</sub></div><div class="formula">I<sub>D</sub> = I<sub>DSS</sub>(1 − U<sub>GS</sub>/U<sub>GS(off)</sub>)²</div><div class="formula">g<sub>m</sub> = Δi<sub>d</sub> / Δu<sub>gs</sub></div><div class="formula">共源基本型：A<sub>u</sub> ≈ −g<sub>m</sub>R′<sub>L</sub></div><div class="note">JFET 自偏置时，常见 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">U<sub>G</sub>≈0</span>，因此可直接写成 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">U<sub>GS</sub>=−I<sub>D</sub>R<sub>S</sub></span>。先把静态关系立起来，再决定后面用解析法还是图解法。</div></div>
</section>
<section class="section"><div class="section-head"><h2>速通</h2></div><div class="quick-grid">
<div class="quick"><div class="n">01 · 认管</div><h3>先锁定课程重点管型</h3><p>优先掌握 N 沟道 JFET 与增强型 NMOS；先认 U<sub>GS</sub> 范围，再进 Q 点。</p></div><div class="quick"><div class="n">02 · 静态</div><h3>Q 点</h3><p>器件方程 × 电路关系联立；多根时只留物理解。</p></div><div class="quick"><div class="n">03 · 工作区</div><h3>别忘了校验</h3><p>用了恒流区公式，最后必须回代检查工作区。</p></div><div class="quick"><div class="n">04 · 交流</div><h3>看到 A<sub>u</sub>/R<sub>i</sub>/R<sub>o</sub> → 先画交流等效</h3><p>中频下耦合/旁路电容近似短路，直流电源交流接地，再换小信号模型。</p></div><div class="quick"><div class="n">05 · 增益</div><h3>共源通常反相</h3><p>共源先记“反相”；再按题设决定是否计入 r<sub>ds</sub>。</p></div><div class="quick"><div class="n">06 · 小信号</div><h3>别把 r<sub>ds</sub> 忘在模型外</h3><p>模型里有 r<sub>ds</sub>；基础题常近似开路，但是否忽略必须看题设。</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="knowledge"><div class="section-head"><h2>知识点详解</h2></div><div class="knowledge-list">
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>01｜JFET：u<sub>GS</sub> 控沟道，u<sub>DS</sub> 推工作区</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">JFET 的原理可以按两个控制变量来理解：先固定 u<sub>DS</sub>，看 u<sub>GS</sub>怎样改变沟道宽度；再固定 u<sub>GS</sub>，看 u<sub>DS</sub>怎样把器件从未夹断推到预夹断，最后进入恒流区。</p><p>N 沟道 JFET 正常工作时要保证栅源 PN 结反偏，可直接记成 u<sub>GS</sub>&lt;0；P 沟道方向相反。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>02｜增强型 / 耗尽型 MOSFET</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">增强型 MOSFET 的第一道门槛是让 u<sub>GS</sub> 超过开启电压 U<sub>GS(th)</sub>：先形成反型层和导电沟道，后面才谈得上漏极电流与工作区；耗尽型 MOSFET 则可以和 JFET 放在一起类比。</p><p>因此增强型 MOSFET 不适合自给偏置：还没有足够的 u<sub>GS</sub>时，就没有漏极电流去建立所需的源极电压。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>03｜看曲线认管型</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">看转移特性认管型时，先看 u<sub>GS</sub> 的取值范围：有正有负，多半对应耗尽型 MOSFET；全为正，对应增强型 MOSFET；全为负，对应 JFET。</p><p>图上与纵轴的关键交点对应饱和漏极电流，与横轴的关键交点对应夹断电压或开启电压。先认管型，再读参数，顺序不要反。P 沟道图形可以先与 N 沟道作镜像类比，再结合电压、电流方向判断。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>04｜自偏置与分压偏置</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">自偏置常用于 JFET、耗尽型 MOSFET；分压偏置适用于各种 FET。因为 FET 输入电阻很大，分析栅极网络时通常先用 I<sub>G</sub>≈0 简化。</p><p>自偏置最常用的电路关系仍是 U<sub>GS</sub>=U<sub>G</sub>−U<sub>S</sub>。先把这条电路关系写清楚，再和器件恒流区公式联立。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>05｜静态 Q 点：解析法 + 图解法</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">两种方法都要会。解析法是把偏置关系和器件方程联立；图解法则是把电路给出的偏置线画到转移特性上，交点就是 Q 点。</p><p>如果方程给出多个数学根，要根据器件工作条件筛掉不合理的根；如果使用了恒流区公式，最后还要反过来校验求出的 Q 点确实落在该工作区。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>06｜低频小信号模型</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">FET 小信号模型是本章核心。动态分析固定成两步：先处理耦合电容、旁路电容和交流地，再把器件替换成 g<sub>m</sub>u<sub>gs</sub> 受控源与 r<sub>ds</sub>。</p><p>不少基础题会按题意把 r<sub>ds</sub>近似开路处理，但是否忽略要看题目条件，不要形成机械习惯。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>07｜共源：最常见动态题</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">共源题最容易因为源极电阻是否被旁路而分成两套。R<sub>S</sub>被旁路时更接近标准共源；没有旁路时，R<sub>S</sub>会进入交流关系，增益表达式也随之变化。</p><p>做题固定成一条链：交流通路 → 小信号模型 → A<sub>u</sub> / R<sub>i</sub> / R<sub>o</sub>。先画对，再算。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>08｜共漏：重点看等效通路和 R<sub>o</sub></summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">共漏放大尤其要会画求输出电阻时的等效通路。它虽然有“电压跟随”的直观特征，但考试真正容易卡住的仍然是交流网络怎么画。</p><p>尤其在求 R<sub>o</sub>时，先按题目要求把独立源置零，再从输出端看进去，不要只凭结构印象写结论。</p></div></details>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="papers"><div class="section-head"><h2>历年真题</h2><p>先识别题型，再套对应模板。每道题只保留最关键的判断、路线和结果。</p></div><div class="coverage-card"><span class="coverage-kicker">Exam Coverage</span>四套卷里 <strong>4/4 都出现了独立 FET 大题</strong>。主线高度稳定：认管型 → Q 点 → 工作区 → 小信号；卷外还要留意曲线认管、r<sub>ds</sub> 和偏置方式这些概念题。</div>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2018–2019 A卷 · 第4题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">JFET</span><span class="tag">自偏置</span><span class="tag">Q 点</span><span class="tag">恒流区</span><span class="tag">小信号</span></div></div><div class="score">8 分 · 母题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2018–2019 A卷 · 第4题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>JFET 自偏置：第一行先立关系</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>I_G≈0，因此先写 U_G≈0，再由源极压降得到 U_GS=−I_D R_S；静态关系立住后再解 Q 点。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>U_G≈0 → U_GS=−I_D R_S → 联立器件方程 → 筛根 → 校验工作区</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>有多个数学根时，只保留满足器件工作条件的物理解。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>第一问把 U<sub>GS</sub>=−I<sub>D</sub>R<sub>S</sub> 单独写清楚。后面的最小电源电压和小信号参数都依赖这个 Q 点。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">I<sub>DQ</sub>≈0.764 mA</span>，最小 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">U<sub>DD</sub>≈6.6 V</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article><article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2019–2020 B卷 · 第8题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">JFET</span><span class="tag">自偏置</span><span class="tag">Q 点</span><span class="tag">小信号</span></div></div><div class="score">6 分 · 迁移题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2019–2020 B卷 · 第8题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,
